- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339-343, 621-623 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard does not recognize `NAME+=` assignments, unlike the template guard, so a command such as `COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x` bypasses inspection of the `git push`.
  WHY: This root/template divergence causes guard tests to fail and can bypass the merged-PR commit guard.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:90 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `activation_normalise_verdict` rejects a valid LIVE verdict when `gaps` is omitted or null instead of treating it as an empty list.
  WHY: The verdict is discarded as invalid, causing activation verification to be skipped.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: CI checks must pass, including the claimed “812 passed with no failures” and the required lint checks.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py was not synchronized with workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py. Because .claude files are excluded from the review editor's Docker workspace snapshot and transfer allowlist, the failure in tests-hooks-and-orchestrator persists on the branch and prevents CI from going green., The root guard at `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339` and `:621` uses `re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=", tokens[index])` — no `\+?` for `NAME+=` append-assignment parsing. The template guard at `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:351` and `:646` uses `re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\+?=", tokens[index])` with additional `+=` handling logic at lines 353-357. The `test_template_copies_are_identical` test (line 998) enforces byte-identical root/template guards and fails on this divergence. The `test_push_parser_guards_real_destination` parametrize case `"COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x"` (line 903) fails because the root guard does not recognize `COUNT+=1` as a leading assignment, so `git push` is not guarded. This is a pre-existing root/template divergence on `main` — this PR does not touch either guard file — but it blocks the PR from merging. The review editor's workspace excludes `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` from its transfer allowlist (agents.md: "other `.github/ai/` and `.claude/` files remain excluded from snapshot and transfer"), so the editor cannot fix it in-session.
- requirement: “The poller retries a project only when a trusted partial marker exists, while fewer than three partial comments exist and for no longer than 30 minutes after the first; failed comment writes cannot extend this window but can cause another attempt within it. A failed first verdict write does not trigger a post-completion retry.”
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` completed-project handling and `run_project_activation_verify`; `scripts/activation_verify.sh` partial-verdict comment construction.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The completed-project path invokes `run_project_activation_verify` unconditionally at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19514-19518`. The helper skips only after finding a terminal verdict marker at lines 580-584; it has no partial-count or 30-minute bound. In `scripts/activation_verify.sh:283`, a failed fix-issue lookup posts no `partial=true` marker. Consequently, partial verdicts and failed verdict writes are retried on subsequent completed-project polls without the specified limit.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
